Description: LM Studio integration present in codebase violating local-only architecture
Root_Cause: Legacy LMStudioProvider and host-gateway configuration allowed external cloud/LM Studio coupling

Description: ChromaDB Rust binding segfault on existing collection access and nested filters
Root_Cause: Rust library crashed when get_or_create_collection was passed metadata on existing collection or nested $eq filters

Description: Missing module-level time import in rag/llm_provider.py throwing NameError
Root_Cause: OllamaProvider.generate called time.time() at line 187 without import time in module scope crashing AI generation

Description: Employee compliance rate displayed 154% in BI dashboard
Root_Cause: Query counted acks across draft/in-review policies and admin users without joining active policies or employee role

Description: Department compliance table reported 600% compliance for Operations and None for HR
Root_Cause: Denominator multiplied dept employees by dept mandatory policies while numerator counted all company acks for that dept

Description: Read rate calculated a tautological 100% of existing acknowledgement records
Root_Cause: Metric computed total_reads / total_acks_all rather than employee coverage across all active policies

Description: Viewing a policy prematurely cleared pending acknowledgements queue
Root_Cause: acked_ids query in blueprints/employee.py omitted acknowledged_at.isnot(None) filter

Description: Compliance readiness score ack_score included non-employee acks
Root_Cause: Query in blueprints/compliance.py did not join User to filter active employees and did not cap at 100.0

Description: Operational parameters scattered with unvalidated types and exposed secrets
Root_Cause: Constants hardcoded across scripts without unified validation or masking of credentials in logs

Description: Session cookie leakage across pytest fixtures causing false 200 on unauth check
Root_Cause: Flask-Login context kept authenticated user state in session without explicit logout in test helper
